# tauri_plugin_dialog

Kind: module
Signature: `pub mod tauri_plugin_dialog`

Native system dialogs for opening and saving files along with message dialogs.

## Cargo features

- **gtk3** *(enabled by default)*: Uses GTK for dialogs on Linux & BSDs; has no effect on Windows and macOS
- **xdg-portal**:  Uses XDG Desktop Portal instead of GTK on Linux & BSDs

# tauri_plugin_dialog::Error

Kind: enum
Defined in: `tauri_plugin_dialog`
Signature: `pub enum Error`

Errors that can occur while showing or interacting with a dialog.

- `Tauri`: An error forwarded from the Tauri core.
- `Io`: An I/O error, for example while resolving a picked path.
- `Fs`: An error forwarded from the `fs` plugin, returned when granting filesystem scope to a picked path fails.

Variants: `Tauri`, `Io`, `Fs`

Trait implementations: `Serialize`

title: tauri_plugin_dialog::FileAccessMode
text:
# tauri_plugin_dialog::FileAccessMode

Kind: enum
Defined in: `tauri_plugin_dialog`
Signature: `pub enum FileAccessMode`

The file access mode of the dialog, used to control how a picked file is exposed to the app on iOS.

- `Copy`: Copy the picked file into the app's sandbox so it can be freely read, edited or deleted.
- `Scoped`: Keep the file at its original location and let the system manage security-scoped access to it.

Variants: `Copy`, `Scoped`

Trait implementations: `Serialize`, `Deserialize<'de>`

title: tauri_plugin_dialog::MessageDialogButtons
text:
# tauri_plugin_dialog::MessageDialogButtons

Kind: enum
Defined in: `tauri_plugin_dialog`
Signature: `pub enum MessageDialogButtons`

Set of button that will be displayed on the dialog

- `Ok`: A single `Ok` button with OS default dialog text
- `OkCancel`: 2 buttons `Ok` and `Cancel` with OS default dialog texts
- `YesNo`: 2 buttons `Yes` and `No` with OS default dialog texts
- `YesNoCancel`: 3 buttons `Yes`, `No` and `Cancel` with OS default dialog texts
- `OkCustom`: A single `Ok` button with custom text
- `OkCancelCustom`: 2 buttons `Ok` and `Cancel` with custom texts
- `YesNoCancelCustom`: 3 buttons `Yes`, `No` and `Cancel` with custom texts

Variants: `Ok`, `OkCancel`, `YesNo`, `YesNoCancel`, `OkCustom`, `OkCancelCustom`, `YesNoCancelCustom`

Trait implementations: `Serialize`, `Deserialize<'de>`

title: tauri_plugin_dialog::MessageDialogResult
text:
# tauri_plugin_dialog::MessageDialogResult

Kind: enum
Defined in: `tauri_plugin_dialog`
Signature: `pub enum MessageDialogResult`

Result of a message dialog

- `Yes`: The user pressed the `Yes` button.
- `No`: The user pressed the `No` button.
- `Ok`: The user pressed the `Ok` button.
- `Cancel`: The user pressed the `Cancel` button, or closed the dialog without pressing a button.
- `Custom`: The user pressed a button with a custom label, holding that label's text.

Variants: `Yes`, `No`, `Ok`, `Cancel`, `Custom`

Trait implementations: `Deserialize<'de>`, `Serialize`

title: tauri_plugin_dialog::PickerMode
text:
# tauri_plugin_dialog::PickerMode

Kind: enum
Defined in: `tauri_plugin_dialog`
Signature: `pub enum PickerMode`

The preferred mode of the file picker on mobile platforms (iOS and Android), which have
distinct file and media pickers. On desktop, this option is ignored.

- `Document`: Show the generic document picker.
- `Media`: Show the media picker, allowing both images and videos to be selected.
- `Image`: Show the media picker restricted to images.
- `Video`: Show the media picker restricted to videos.

Variants: `Document`, `Media`, `Image`, `Video`

Trait implementations: `Serialize`, `Deserialize<'de>`
